arrive.text: A clear night. More stars than anyone could count.

arrive_2.text: In the hut, the receiver is on. It always is.

listen.text: Only static. The hiss of the stars.

stars.text: Billions of stars, and around most of them, planets.

old.text: Some are far older than the Sun. Someone should have come by now.

choose.text: You could sit here and keep listening. Or you could call out.

not_yet.text: Not yet. First, hear what the receiver hears.

year_10.text: Ten years. Maybe they're rare. Maybe they don't last.

year_40.text: Forty years. Maybe they're quiet. Maybe we're early.

send_1.text: Your message leaves at the speed of light.

send_2.text: Years pass. It has barely left the neighbourhood.

send_3.text: From the nearest star, an answer would take eight years. From most, thousands.

send_4.text: Nothing yet. Maybe no one heard. Or someone did, and is deciding whether to answer.

logbook.text: The log goes back years. Every night, the same word: nothing. Except one night, near the end. Heard something. Didn't answer.

logbook_again.text: The log goes back years. Every night, nothing. And one new line, near the end. Yours.

tea.text: Your tea has gone cold. It always does, out here.

moon.text: Only one other world has ever had footprints. Twelve people walked there, and came home.
